profile.headline: N4 Certified Software Engineer at Smart Building Technologies

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Interpret blueprints and mechanical specs to write logic that dictates how equipment (like chillers, boilers, and air handling units) should behave.  create the Front-End—the visual dashboard that building operators use everyday. Data mapping. Alarming and trending. Integrating devices using industry-standard protocols like BACnet, Modbus, or LonWorks. Configuring IP addresses, subnets, and gateways to ensure the BAS can communicate over the building’s IT infrastructure. Functional Testing; Verifying that when the code says "Open Valve," the physical valve actually opens.
Remote Support: Accessing systems remotely to diagnose why a building is too hot or why an energy spike occurred.
positions.insights: Skills: Interpersonal Skills · Software Deployment · Communication · Computer Hardware Troubleshooting · Oral Communication · Troubleshooting · Service-Level Agreements (SLA) · Software Development

positions.title: Customer Care / Sales Specialist
positions.description:
Customer Care & Sales Specialist.
Ensured every caller satisfaction by responding in a timely manner and efficiently. Provided Ritz Carlton world class customer service as well as lateral service to the ladies and gentlemen serving on site at the many hotels located throughout the United States. Continuously met or exceeded sales goals as well as service requirements that lived up to Ritz Carlton standards.

positions.title: Vacation Planner
positions.description: Ensured every travel agent satisfaction by assisting them in creating cruise packages for their guests; for the many ships that represent NCL which sailed to and from many different ports of the United States. Continuously met satisfaction requirements and call guideline goals.
